feladatok.cim: Email to Rachel about her sister's student loan
feladatok.helyzet: You read the following post on the internet forum Q&A:

bekezdesek: I’ve got an 18-year-old sister called Becky; she’s leaving school this year and going to university. I got a little worried when I found brochures from various banks in her room and she said that she was thinking of taking out a bank loan. She’s even visited the website of one of the banks and said that she “found the adverts for student loans very convincing”.

I know that many young people do the same for their university fees. But this is not the case with her because our parents have saved up the money. Actually, what she wants is “financial independence”. She is planning to rent a flat with her friends who come from much wealthier families, but our family simply can’t afford this! I think it’s very dangerous to get into debt these days – and also very foolish if you don’t really have to. But when I tried talking to her about it, she said I was just being jealous.
Is there anything I should do? I’d appreciate your opinion.

feladatok.teendo: Write an email of 100-120 words to Rachel in which you say
iranyito_szempontok: what you think of student loans,
what you think of people spending too much just because their friends are doing so,

kimaradt.megjegyzes: „He sent you a picture of the Museum of Science and Industry” – a helyzet a lapon lévő fotóra utal.
